jobs.description:
Satellit is seeking an experienced .NET developer with Java know-how to join a multi-disciplinary team delivering digital identity and authentication capabilities for a major energy-sector engagement. The role involves building, validating and documenting reusable authentication/authorization components, contributing to deployment automation, collaborating with IT stakeholders, and participating in agile squad activities. This position follows a hybrid work model with an expectation of being on-site about two days per week and is planned to start in the mid-October to mid-November timeframe. Full-time commitment is required.
Who are you?

Skills & competences:

• Autonomy

• Teamwork

• Presentation skills

• Communication

• Continuous learning

• Technical documentation

• Analytical problem solving

• Resilience

• Versatility and adaptability

• Continuous integration and deployment practices

• Agile methodologies and Scrum

What will you do?

• Design, implement, unit-test and document libraries, services or components that handle user authentication and authorization.

• Create example applications and code samples to illustrate how to integrate identity and access services into new or existing systems, and communicate these to engineering teams.

• Customize and extend commercial or open-source products (for example access managers, authorization engines, API gateways, reverse proxies and directory services) and produce supporting documentation for those extensions.

• Improve and automate continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows, including configuration and release automation.

• Work closely with IT and application teams to identify integration points, diagnose issues, and resolve problems when connecting to identity Fabric services.

• Install and configure third-party and open-source components by following technical guides and producing any required deployment notes.

• Take part in squad sprint activities, including planning, execution and retrospective work.

• Own assigned backlog items, drive tasks to completion and report progress to the squad.

• Prepare for and actively participate in meetings and workshops, tracking actions and follow-ups.

• Propose technical solutions that align with requirements and constraints, present them to stakeholders and refine based on feedback.

• Continuously acquire new technical knowledge, standards and tooling needed to fulfill assigned work.

Technologies (mandatory)

• Hash Function

• cookie

• SAML/OAuth

• Keystore

• MicroServices Architecture

• Bash

• TypeScript

• OAuth 2

• Security

• Symmetric Encryption

• Proxy

• JSON

• cors

• Innovation

• Scrum

• Vue.js

• OpenID

• Azure AKS

• asymmetric encryption

• Java

• LDAP

• Collaboration

• Solution Architect

• Azure MFA

• SSO

• .NET

• C#

• IDP Platform

• PowerShell

• GIT

• agile

• MS Teams

• product backlog management

• SAP IDM

• Continuous Integration

• Kubernetes

• Google OIDC

• SQL Server

• React Native

• advanced rest

• HTTPS

• SQL

• DevOps

• JavaScript

• YAML

• Blazor

• PKI

• Proven experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem in a production environment.

• Practical knowledge of Java and familiarity with interoperation between Java and .NET components.

• Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with JSON and YAML configurations.

• Hands-on skills with front-end technologies such as JavaScript and frameworks like Vue.js or Blazor.

• Understanding of directory services and authentication protocols (LDAP, OAuth2, OpenID Connect).

• Solid grasp of web security fundamentals including HTTPS, cookies, CORS, single sign-on and multifactor concepts.

• Familiarity with cryptographic basics including symmetric and asymmetric key usage, hashing and keystore concepts.

• Experience deploying and operating containerized applications and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes (experience with managed clusters a plus).

• Comfortable using GIT and participating in DevOps practices for source control and delivery pipelines.

• Database experience, for instance with SQL Server or similar relational databases.

• Nice-to-have: TypeScript, PowerShell, Bash scripting, React, SAML2, PKI experience, and familiarity with identity provider solutions (for example Keycloak, Ping, Okta, ADFS, or cloud identity services).

• Experience designing or operating MicroServices-based systems is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal and soft skills: pragmatic problem-solving, autonomy, adaptability, resilience, clear communication, analytical thinking, and the ability to document and present technical work.

• Language requirements: good command of Dutch and/or French, plus English for technical collaboration.

jobs.occupation: Huxley Associates Belgium - PHP / JavaScript Developer
jobs.description:

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

 

!! Please note: you do NOT qualify if you're not already living in Belgium and don't have legal permission to work in the country !!

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

Worklocation: Diegem/Machelen   travelling 30%

• Conduct market research and identify emerging technologies and innovative companies.
• Explore strategic partnerships and investment opportunities.

• Support business growth strategies and market-entry initiatives.
• Collaborate with international teams to align regional and global objectives.

Your Profile:

• Bachelor's degree (Master's is a plus).
• Fluent in English.
• Experience in procurement, purchasing, sales, or business development; previous experience within the company is a strong asset.
• Familiarity with Genchi Genbutsu and Kaizen principles is a plus.
• Technical or engineering background preferred, or a strong interest in business development.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN
jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN to strengthen its Customer Service team on a temporary basis. Acting as a key liaison between customers and internal stakeholders, the successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring an efficient order-to-cash process while delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international manufacturing and distribution company recognised for its commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Operating across multiple markets, the organisation offers a fast-paced and collaborative environment where teamwork and continuous improvement drive success.

Description

As a Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN your responsibilities are:

• Manage the complete order-to-cash process for a portfolio of domestic and international customers.
• Process, release, and monitor customer orders received through various channels, including e-commerce platforms, email, phone, and EDI.
• Provide customers with timely updates regarding order status, product availability, pricing, promotions, shipment tracking, and related documentation.
• Maintain accurate customer purchase order records within the ERP system for compliance and audit purposes.
• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain and Planning teams to validate customer demand against inventory availability.
• Manage backorders proactively and communicate alternative solutions when supply shortages arise.
• Coordinate shipments from multiple production sites and third-party suppliers while ensuring on-time delivery.
• Prepare and verify shipping, export, and customer-specific documentation.
• Handle debit and credit note administration.
• Respond to customer enquiries and manage claims related to logistics, quality, pricing, warranty, transport, and other service issues.
• Escalate complex cases according to internal procedures and ensure prompt resolution.
• Work cross-functionally with Sales, Logistics, Finance, Compliance, Marketing, and Product teams.
• Produce operational reports and analyse business data to support decision-making.
• Identify opportunities for process optimisation and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support the implementation of best practices and departmental performance standards.

A successful Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN should have:

• Holds a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• Has initial experience within Customer Service, Customer Support, Order Management, Sales Administration, or Supply Chain Administration.
• Is fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Possesses a good working knowledge of French.
• Additional language skills are considered a strong asset.
• Has experience working with ERP systems, ideally SAP SD (Sales & Distribution).
• Demonstrates excellent proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint.
• Has strong communication, organisation, and stakeholder management skills.
• Is customer-focused and solutions-oriented.
• Can work independently while also being an effective team player.
• Remains calm and efficient in a fast-paced environment.
• Displays strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.
• Adopts a continuous improvement mindset and strives for service excellence.
